Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 8 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Storm RAMIL
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 19 October 2025(Sunday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales(Santa Cruz, Candelaria, Masinloc, Palauig, Iba).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Zambales(Olongapo, Subic, Botolan, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Castillejos, San Antonio, San Felipe, San Narciso), Tarlac(Mayantoc, San Jose, Capas, Bamban), Pampanga(Porac, Floridablanca, Lubao, Mabalacat, Guagua, Santa Rita, Angeles, Bacolor, San Fernando, Mexico) and Nueva Ecija(Carranglan, Pantabangan).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Metro Manila, Rizal, Quezon and Laguna within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Cavite, Batangas, Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Camiling, Moncada, San Clemente, Santa Ignacia), Nueva Ecija(Cabiao, Gapan, General Tinio, San Antonio, San Isidro, Aliaga, Bongabon, Cabanatuan, Cuyapo, Gabaldon, General Mamerto Natividad, Guimba, Jaen, Laur, Licab, Llanera, Lupao, Nampicuan, Palayan, Penaranda, Quezon, Rizal, San Jose, San Leonardo, Santa Rosa, Santo Domingo, Munoz, Talavera, Talugtug, Zaragoza), Pampanga(Sasmuan, Apalit, Arayat, Candaba, Macabebe, Magalang, Masantol, Minalin, San Luis, San Simon, Santa Ana, Santo Tomas) and Bulacan(Angat, Balagtas, Baliuag, Bocaue, Bulakan, Bustos, Calumpit, Malolos, Meycauayan, Guiguinto, Hagonoy, Marilao, Obando, Pandi, Paombong, Plaridel, Pulilan, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael, Santa Maria) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
